title: The Sinking Mother
text: A woman stands waist-deep in the black water, her arms held out, humming a lullaby you almost know. The water around her does not ripple. She looks at the most tired of you as if she has waited for them all her life.

options.label: Let them go to her, if her arms are what they need.

outcomes.text: She holds them under gently for a long time. What climbs out is green and dripping, though it still knows your names.
She kisses their brow and is gone. They return calmer, clutching a gift from her that they will let no one else touch.
She will not let go. The water is bitterly cold and very deep before the others drag them free.

options.label: Walk on, eyes front. No mother waits in water like that.

outcomes.text: The humming follows you for a while, then stops. The Leader still hears it, and walks into the next fight half in a dream.
The humming follows you all day. By evening, some of you are humming along without meaning to.

options.label: The Minstrel hums her tune back to her, gently, as a child might.

outcomes.text: She stops to listen, then sinks out of sight with a smile. The tune belongs to the Minstrel now, and there is power in it.
She stops to listen. When she sinks, she takes the Minstrel's voice down into the water with her.
